input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for user details, jwt authentication failure handler, jwt authentication success handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with captcha functionality, so that I can accomplish my captcha-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with social connect functionality, so that I can accomplish my social connect-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with social sign up functionality, so that I can accomplish my social sign up-related tasks.
